nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in constructor and changed by transferOwnership
Haltable.halted: emergency stop flag toggled by halt()/unhalt()
ERC20/SolarDaoToken totalSupply: total number of minted tokens
SolarDaoToken.crowdsaleAgent: privileged address allowed to mint and to bypass the transfer lock
SolarDaoToken.released: transfer lock flag flipped by releaseTokenTransfer()
SolarDaoToken.allowed: nested mapping of owner/spender allowances
SolarDaoToken.balances: mapping of holder address to token balance
Crowdsale constant prefunding goal in USD cents
Crowdsale constant ICO funding goal in USD cents
Crowdsale constant minimal ICO goal in USD cents
Crowdsale constant token price in USD cents (100)
Crowdsale.token: the SolarDaoToken contract being sold
Crowdsale.multisigWallet: team wallet receiving raised ether and bonus tokens
Crowdsale.startsAt: UNIX timestamp of ICO start
Crowdsale.endsAt: UNIX timestamp of ICO end, mutable by setEndsAt()
Crowdsale.preInvestStart: UNIX timestamp of pre-investment start
Crowdsale.tokensSold: number of tokens already sold
Crowdsale.loadedRefund: wei loaded back into the contract for refunds
Crowdsale.finalized: flag set once the crowdsale has been finalized
Crowdsale.exchangeRate: USD cents per ether, set by the exchange rate agent
Crowdsale.exchangeRateTimestamp: timestamp associated with the last rate update
Crowdsale.exchangeRateAgent: privileged address allowed to update exchangeRate
Crowdsale.milestones: array of Milestone structs defining bonus phases
Haltable.halt: owner-only emergency stop setting halted = true
Haltable.unhalt: owner-only removal of the emergency stop
SolarDaoToken payable fallback that always reverts
SolarDaoToken.setCrowdsaleAgent: owner-only setter for crowdsaleAgent while unreleased
SolarDaoToken.releaseTokenTransfer: one-way unlock of token transfers
SolarDaoToken.transfer: balance-moving ERC20 transfer gated by canTransfer and payload size
SolarDaoToken.transferFrom: allowance-based transfer updating balances and allowed
SolarDaoToken.approve: allowance setter with race-condition mitigation
SolarDaoToken.canTransfer modifier: while unreleased only crowdsaleAgent may move tokens
SolarDaoToken.inReleaseState modifier comparing argument to released
SolarDaoToken.onlyPayloadSize modifier defending against the ERC20 short address attack
Killable.kill: owner-only selfdestruct sending funds to owner
Crowdsale constructor validating dates and building the milestone schedule
Crowdsale payable fallback that calls buy()
Crowdsale.buy: payable entry point calling invest(msg.sender)
Crowdsale.invest: payable public wrapper around investInternal
Crowdsale.investInternal: core investment logic, accounting and ether forwarding
Crowdsale.setExchangeRate: agent-only rate update with sanity bounds
Crowdsale.loadRefund: payable funding of the refund pool in Failure state
Crowdsale.refund: investor refund claiming, zeroes investment then transfers ether
Crowdsale.getState: state machine based on time, funds and flags
Crowdsale.calculateTokens: converts wei to token amount using the exchange rate
Crowdsale.assignTokens: private external call to token.mint()
Crowdsale.getCurrentMilestone: scans milestones for the active bonus period
Crowdsale.inState modifier requiring a given State
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization, balances and refunds
Miner-influenced timestamp used by the crowdsale state machine and rate checks
assert(a == 0 || c / a == b) guarding multiplication overflow
assert(b > 0) and round-trip assertion guarding division
selfdestruct(owner) destroying the contract and forwarding balance
msg.sender.transfer(weiValue) external ether transfer inside refund()
multisigWallet.transfer(weiAmount) external ether transfer inside investInternal()
External call token.mint(receiver, tokenAmount) inside assignTokens()
require(exchangeRateTimestamp == 0 || getDifference(time, now) <= 1 minutes) timestamp-window check
require(time >= now) timestamp dependency in setEndsAt()
require(getDifference(value, exchangeRate) * 100 / exchangeRate <= 30) rate-deviation arithmetic bound
uint parameter size used in the msg.data.length check
local bonus array for the pre-ICO milestones
local bonus array for the ICO milestones
loop index used to build milestones
local var tokensAmount computed by calculateTokens plus bonus
local var teamBonusTokens for the team wallet
uint parameter value: new USD cents per ether
uint parameter time: timestamp associated with the rate
uint parameter time: new end timestamp
address parameter receiver of minted tokens
loop index scanning the milestones array

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require, so caller control gates every owner-only function
msg.sender gates the onlyCrowdsaleAgent require used by mint and releaseTokenTransfer
msg.sender gates the onlyExchangeRateAgent require for setExchangeRate
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping keyed by msg.sender
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[_from][msg.sender] and balances[_from]
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
canTransfer restricts token movement to msg.sender == crowdsaleAgent while unreleased
onlyCrowdsaleAgent modifier compares msg.sender with crowdsaleAgent
invest forwards the caller-supplied receiver and is invoked with msg.sender by buy
refund reads investedAmountOf[msg.sender] and sends ether back to msg.sender, coupling caller identity with the payout
block.timestamp is compared with exchangeRateTimestamp and with the supplied time to accept recent rate updates
setEndsAt requires the new end time to be >= now, a timestamp dependency controllable by miners
getState compares now against preInvestStart, startsAt and endsAt to derive the sale state
getCurrentMilestone selects the bonus tier by comparing now with milestone start/end
The rate update window check depends on now, allowing miner timestamp manipulation
The require(time >= now) guard evaluates an untrusted timestamp
Ownable constructor writes owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership mutates the privileged owner state variable
SolarDaoToken constructor writes owner = msg.sender
halt sets the privileged halted flag to true
unhalt resets the privileged halted flag to false
mint increases totalSupply using safeAdd
mint credits balances[receiver] using safeAdd
setCrowdsaleAgent writes the privileged crowdsaleAgent address
releaseTokenTransfer flips the released lock flag
transfer mutates balances via safeSub/safeAdd
transferFrom mutates balances[_to] and balances[_from] via safeAdd/safeSub
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance via safeSub
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] after the zero-allowance guard
Crowdsale constructor assigns the token under sale
Crowdsale constructor assigns the multisig wallet that receives ether and bonus tokens
Crowdsale constructor sets startsAt
Crowdsale constructor sets endsAt
Crowdsale constructor sets preInvestStart
Crowdsale constructor pushes the pre-ICO and ICO milestone entries
investInternal accumulates investedAmountOf[receiver] with safeAdd
investInternal accumulates tokenAmountOf[receiver] with safeAdd
investInternal accumulates tokensSold with safeAdd
investInternal accumulates weiRaised with safeAdd, the value used by goal checks
investInternal increments investorCount for first-time investors
finalize sets the finalized flag, a privileged state transition
setExchangeRate writes the price used for token accounting
setExchangeRate writes the rate timestamp used by the freshness check
setExchangeRateAgent rotates the privileged exchange rate agent
setCrowdsaleData overwrites tokensSold during migration
setCrowdsaleData overwrites weiRaised, directly affecting goal checks
setCrowdsaleData overwrites investorCount
setEndsAt mutates the sale end timestamp controlling the Funding state
loadRefund accumulates loadedRefund with safeAdd from msg.value
refund zeroes investedAmountOf[msg.sender] before the external transfer
refund increments weiRefunded and then performs an external ether transfer
The payable fallback forwards all plain ether transfers to buy()
buy delegates to invest(msg.sender)
invest delegates to the internal investInternal logic
investInternal calls getState() to validate the sale state
investInternal calls calculateTokens(weiAmount)
investInternal calls assignTokens for the investor and the team bonus
investInternal calls getCurrentMilestone() to compute the pre-funding bonus
finalize invokes finalizeCrowdsale()
getState evaluates isMinimumGoalReached() for the Success/Failure decision
getState evaluates isCrowdsaleFull() for the Funding decision
getState evaluates isMaximumPreFundingGoalReached() for the PreFunding decision
isMinimumGoalReached converts weiRaised using weiToUsdCents
isCrowdsaleFull converts weiRaised using weiToUsdCents
isMaximumPreFundingGoalReached converts weiRaised using weiToUsdCents
calculateTokens converts the incoming wei with weiToUsdCents
safeMul asserts the product has not overflowed
safeDiv asserts the divisor and the division round trip
safeSub asserts b <= a to prevent underflow
safeAdd asserts the sum has not overflowed
mint relies on safeAdd for totalSupply and balances updates
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender balance debit
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit
transferFrom relies on safeSub for balances[_from] and the allowance
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for balances[_to]
investInternal uses safeAdd for all accounting accumulators
investInternal uses safeSub indirectly through the safe math family for accounting integrity
investInternal computes the team bonus with safeDiv(..., 100 - TEAM_BONUS_PERCENT)
investInternal computes the team bonus with safeMul(tokensAmount, TEAM_BONUS_PERCENT)
calculateTokens multiplies usdAmount by the unit multiplier with safeMul
calculateTokens divides the multiplier by PRICE with safeDiv
weiToUsdCents multiplies weiValue by exchangeRate with safeMul
weiToUsdCents divides by 1e18 with safeDiv
loadRefund adds msg.value to loadedRefund with safeAdd
refund adds the payout to weiRefunded with safeAdd
kill executes selfdestruct(owner), destroying the contract and moving funds to the owner
assignTokens performs an external call into the token contract which can re-enter the crowdsale before state is settled
finalizeCrowdsale performs an external call to token.releaseTokenTransfer()
refund sends ether to msg.sender via transfer after zeroing the investment, a classic refund reentrancy surface
investInternal forwards the raised ether to multisigWallet via transfer inside the investment path
